headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Weathered Expanse as Marban Hollow and Nevish Shift
war_summary: Fresh shifts along the central and northern fronts have kept battle lines fluid over the past three hours. Weathered Expanse continues to churn in furious contention, logging five additional base transitions and over sixteen hundred casualties in two hours, leaving the snowfields divided between five Colonial holdings, two Warden bastions, and two scorched neutral grounds. Marban Hollow matched that tempo with six rapid turnovers around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, repairing previous ruins into an active four-to-three Warden advantage with a single base in no-man's-land. High-intensity combat along the Nevish Line claimed another twenty-one hundred casualties across four base exchanges, allowing Colonial forces to secure a third redoubt against five Warden strongpoints. Though infantry exchanges in Kuura Strand cooled substantially from earlier spikes, the sector logged four further flips to preserve a five-to-one Colonial dominance. In Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle, severe artillery duels and localized skirmishes produced heavy casualties—exceeding eighteen hundred combined losses in Linn of Mercy alone—yet strategic positions held firm without yielding new ground.
